title: The AI system I use to plan 60 posts a month (3 prompts)
caption: Never run out of content ideas again. 3 prompts, one afternoon, a full month planned. Screenshot the prompts. #contentcreation #aitools #ecommercemarketing #creatortips

beats.headline: 60 posts. | *One* system.
beats.say: I post *twice* a day, and I never run out of ideas. Here's the AI system behind it.

beats.headline: Steal the *system*
beats.say: Three prompts, one afternoon, a full *month* planned.

beats.headline: The blank page | *kills* brands.
beats.say: [sigh] The blank page kills more brands than bad *products.*

beats.headline: The last one | does the *work.*
beats.say: Three steps. The last one does the *work* for you.

visual.prompt: You're my content strategist. I sell [product] to [customer]. Give me 5 content pillars, each with 3 pain points.

beats.say: One. *Tell* any AI: you're my content strategist, here's what I sell and who buys it. Give me five content pillars, each with three pain points.
Two. Copy every question from your comments, reviews, and support emails. *Every* question someone asks is a video someone wants.

visual.prompt: For each pillar, write 12 hooks under 10 words, using these customer questions. Mix mistakes, myths, how-tos.
reply: "The size chart is lying to you"

beats.say: [surprise-oh] Three. *Paste* those questions back in and ask for twelve hooks per pillar, under ten words. Five pillars times twelve is sixty posts.
Then *schedule* it. Morning post: a quick win. Evening post: a deep dive. Record them all in one session.
Bonus. Every month, *take* your top posts and repost them with a new hook. Winners win twice.

beats.headline: Questions are | *content.*
beats.say: Your customers are literally telling you what to *post.*

beats.headline: Follow for *more*
beats.say: *Save* this, steal the system, and follow for more.
